Documentation → Other Products → Placeholder ADOMs

Placeholder ADOMs

A placeholder ADOM is a branded, selectable workspace with no product backend yet; it shows a scaffold dashboard and a minimal sidebar until real pages exist.

👤 ForAdministrator
🔑 Permissionsusers.manage
📍 WhereSettings → Fleet & Devices → ADOMs (flag "Placeholder (scaffold only)"); home page /product/home
On this page
  • What a placeholder ADOM is
  • What users see
  • Managing the flag

What a placeholder ADOM is#

The list of ADOMs (Global, FortiWeb, FortiADC, FortiAuthenticator, FortiAnalyzer, FortiGate and any you add) is stored in the database and edited under Settings → Fleet & Devices → ADOMs. Each ADOM row has a flag Placeholder (scaffold only). A placeholder ADOM can be selected and has its own name, logo, tagline and banner colour, but no product pages of its own.

None of the six shipped ADOMs is a placeholder: FortiAuthenticator, FortiAnalyzer and FortiGate started as placeholders and now have real workspaces. A new ADOM created in Settings has the placeholder box ticked by default.

What users see#

  • Home page — choosing the ADOM (product selector, or ADOMs in the Global sidebar) opens /product/home, titled with the ADOM name and tagline. It shows Scaffold ready and the text The <name> ADOM is in place with its own branding and personal top-bar banner. Modules (…) will be added here., with the buttons Global ADOM and Switch product.
  • Sidebar — ‹ Global, a section named after the ADOM with a single Dashboard entry, and the shared Automation group (for users with a key that grants configuration writes). The bottom block keeps Documentation and Settings.
  • If the placeholder flag is later cleared on an ADOM that has no dedicated workspace, /product/home sends the user to the FortiWeb home instead.

Managing the flag#

  1. Open Settings → Fleet & Devices → ADOMs (administrators with users.manage).
  2. Tick or clear Placeholder (scaffold only) on the ADOM and save.
  3. The change reaches every server process within about 15 seconds (the ADOM registry is cached briefly).

ℹ️Note

Only FortiADC, FortiAnalyzer and FortiAuthenticator have dedicated workspaces. Clearing the placeholder flag on any other ADOM does not create pages for it.
